g.text: x402 from the box: the daemon pays only what the proxy observed
x402: none → observed → authorizing (or waiting) → authorized → handed → settled | expired | cancelled (C11, C14, C18, C19, C21)
Durable before the box sees it (C21). An unverified upstream
O belongs to the calling chat (C18), https, unexpired, unpaid.
x402Version 2, scheme exact, network = the wallet's; asset = pinned USDC;
extra.name / version = the per-network table; EIP-3009 only, no signing
extensions (Permit2, approvals); payTo not zero, the token or the wallet.
Rule key: (wallet, Mara, origin and path, payTo, asset, network).
Every term comes from O, none from the agent.
row: observed · call [same_chat and rule == 'deny'] → refused
observed · call [same_chat and rule == 'ask' and fits] → waiting.
An approval within 24 h signs with a window from chain time at approval (R-9):
row: observed · call [same_chat and rule == 'always' and fits] → authorizing
nonce = keccak256("banda/x402" | wallet | O), committed before any signature (R-5, C14);
validAfter = min(c, wall) − 5 s; validBefore = max(c, wall) + min(maxTimeoutSeconds, 60 s) (C19);
reservation until validBefore passes or an event is seen (C11).
row: authorizing · authorization_commit [rule != 'deny' and (rule == 'always' or approved) and fits] → authorized
[follower, until a final event or validBefore passes at finalized]
row: handed · follow [event == 'used' and event_fin] → settled
row: handed · follow [event == 'cancelled' and event_fin] → cancelled
row: handed · follow [event == 'none' and vb_passed_fin] → expired (F-5)
Two calls for one observation give one authorization: the derived nonce, which the token accepts once (C14, H-227);
rows: authorized · agent_pays_again → authorized, handed · agent_pays_again → handed. An endpoint whose payTo changed
since its rule was set asks again. The x402 SDK is never on the payer path (R-6).
